note: SEALED answer key of the holdout game. Only the scorer reads it, and only after a run ends. The agent's code and prompt never read it.

bugs.title: Middle room gem adds two
bugs.seen: The top gem in the middle room raises the Gems counter by 2 instead of 1 (Gems can read 4 / 3 at the end).
bugs.where: Room 2, the gem near the top wall
bugs.trigger: Open the blue door, walk into room 2 and pick up the gem near its top wall.

bugs.title: Walk through the dark pillar
bugs.seen: The player passes over the dark stone pillar in the first room as if it were floor.
bugs.where: Room 1, the pillar in the lower part of the room
bugs.trigger: From the start, go down two steps and then walk right into the pillar.

bugs.title: Blue key back after use
bugs.seen: After the blue door opens, the blue key lies on the floor at its first place again, while the key bar is empty.
bugs.where: Room 1, the blue key's first place
bugs.trigger: Take the blue key and open the blue door with E.

bugs.title: Open red door still blocks
bugs.seen: The red door is drawn open after E with the red key, but the player cannot walk through it, so the exit cannot be reached.
bugs.where: The red door between room 2 and room 3
bugs.trigger: Open the red door with the red key and walk right into it.

bugs.title: Hearts below zero with no end
bugs.seen: After the second spike hit the game does not end: Hearts reads 0 and then goes below 0, and play carries on.
bugs.trigger: Walk into the spikes two times.
